A secondary AI-product guide describes Leadership Principles, a written exercise and a Bar Raiser. Engineering topics come from a compilation. Neither source establishes a universal current loop.

## Roles covered

- **AI Engineering:** AI / LLM engineer
- **AI Leadership:** AI product manager (senior to group)

## Questions reported for Amazon

### [LLM fundamentals](../themes/llm-fundamentals.md)

- **Derive the memory required by a decoder's KV cache as batch size and context length grow.**
  - Knowledge · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †, [OpenAI](openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether cache size is calculated from the actual architecture.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - For equal sequence lengths, use 2 × batch × layers × tokens × KV heads × head width × bytes.
    - Explain why queries are not retained for future decode steps.
    - Account separately for weights, activations, padding and allocation overhead.
  - Read: [Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.06180) (Kwon et al., arXiv) · [GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13245) (Ainslie et al., arXiv)

### [Inference, serving and cost](../themes/inference-economics.md)

- **Compare tensor, pipeline, data, sequence and expert parallelism for a large model deployment.**
  - Knowledge · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †, [Google and Google DeepMind](google.md) †, [Meta](meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether communication patterns and memory limits determine the choice.
- **You are asked to reduce serving cost by an order of magnitude. Rank the levers and explain how you would test whether that target is achievable.**
  - Applied scenario · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †, [Microsoft](microsoft.md) †
  - Tests: Whether savings are measured under explicit quality and latency constraints.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Measure cost per successful task at the required quality and SLO.
    - Compare smaller models, shorter contexts, reuse, batching and precision changes.
    - Benchmark each change and check whether the combined savings actually reach the target.
  - Read: [Optimizing inference](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/llm_optims) (Hugging Face Transformers docs) · [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google)
- **After a deployment, p99 latency doubles although model weights are unchanged. How do you isolate the cause?**
  - Applied scenario · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †, [Databricks](databricks.md) †, [OpenAI](openai.md) †, [Perplexity](perplexity.md) †
  - Tests: Whether diagnosis separates queueing, scheduling, dependencies and traffic changes.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Compare traffic mix, queue time and per-stage latency before and after release.
    - Inspect cache hit rates, batching, dependency tails and resource saturation.
    - Reproduce one hypothesis at a time and use a rollback or canary to verify causality.
  - Read: [The Tail at Scale](https://research.google/pubs/the-tail-at-scale/) (Dean and Barroso, Google Research)

### [AI system design](../themes/ai-system-design.md)

- **Design a knowledge assistant over ten million enterprise documents with per-user permissions and a continuously changing corpus.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †, [Databricks](databricks.md) †, [Microsoft](microsoft.md) †, [OpenAI](openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether ingestion, retrieval, access control and serving form an operable system.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Clarify query volume, freshness and permission semantics before sizing.
    - Separate ingestion and index versions from query-time authorisation and retrieval.
    - Evaluate grounded answers and test revocation, stale data and partial outages.
  - Read: [Document-level access control](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/search/search-document-level-access-overview) (Microsoft Learn) · [Contextual Retrieval in AI Systems](https://www.anthropic.com/news/contextual-retrieval) (Anthropic)

### [Practical coding](../themes/coding-practical.md)

- **Implement scaled dot-product attention with a causal mask and tests that would expose attention to future tokens.**
  - Coding · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †, [Anthropic](anthropic.md) †, [Google and Google DeepMind](google.md) †
  - Tests: Whether shapes, masking and numerical stability are correct in executable code.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Check batch, sequence and head dimensions before implementing score multiplication.
    - Use stable softmax after masking disallowed positions.
    - Test small hand-computable cases and ensure changing future inputs cannot change earlier outputs.
  - Read: [Attention Is All You Need](https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762) (Vaswani et al., arXiv)

### [AI product strategy and metrics](../themes/ai-product-strategy.md)

- **Choose an AI agent or product you use and propose its most valuable improvement.**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †
  - Tests: Whether product judgement rests on observed friction and a testable hypothesis.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Describe a real workflow and where the product fails the user.
    - Explain why the proposed improvement outranks alternatives.
    - Specify a prototype, success measure and possible adverse effect.
  - Read: [Measuring the User Experience on a Large Scale: User-Centered Metrics for Web Applications](https://research.google/pubs/measuring-the-user-experience-on-a-large-scale-user-centered-metrics-for-web-applications/) (Rodden, Hutchinson and Fu, Google Research)

### [Programmes and delivery](../themes/program-delivery.md)

- **Three weeks before launching an LLM feature, evaluation reveals substantial hallucinations on edge cases. What happens next?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you make a risk-based launch decision rather than protecting the date at any cost.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Check severity, prevalence, affected users and the reliability of the evaluation.
    - Compare narrowing scope, adding review, fixing causes and delaying release.
    - Assign a decision owner, explicit exit criteria and a communication plan.
  - Read: [AI Risk Management Framework](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework) (NIST) · [Demystifying evals for AI agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/demystifying-evals-for-ai-agents) (Anthropic)
- **How would you roll out updates to Alexa devices already deployed in people's homes?**
  - System design · Senior · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you account for fleet diversity, interrupted updates and safe rollout.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Clarify update scope, compatibility, connectivity and user disruption.
    - Use controlled cohorts, health checks and recoverable installation.
    - Define rollout pauses, rollback ownership and support communication.
  - Read: [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google)

### [Behavioral and values](../themes/behavioral-values.md)

- **Tell me about a time you disagreed with someone and could not persuade them.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you work constructively after losing an argument.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - State both positions fairly and explain your evidence.
    - Describe the decision process and how you supported the agreed action.
    - Explain the result, limits of commitment and what you learned.
  - Read: [Leadership Principles](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/our-workplace/leadership-principles) (Amazon Jobs)
- **Tell me about an opportunity you saw that was larger than the original scope of your assignment.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you recognise broader value and justify taking on additional scope.
- **Tell me about an AI decision you owned that had significant downstream consequences.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you consider impact beyond your immediate deliverable.
